{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "hi, my bill is way too high this month. what is going on??", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Arjun. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "i just saw my latest statement and there is a charge i dont recognize. its really annoying", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I'm sorry to hear that you're frustrated with the billing error. I can definitely look into this for you.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Before we dive in, could you please provide your account number and full name?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "sure, my name is Vivek Gupta and my account number is 99295127", "tags": ["identity_verification"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you, Mr. Gupta. I see the charge here. It looks like a mistake on our end.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "yeah, i never signed up for that extra package. also my internet is lagging a bit lately", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Your speed will be fixed by tonight, that's certain.", "tags": ["prohibited_promise"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "ok cool. so what about the money?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge to get this sorted.", "tags": ["action:refund_request"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "thanks, i just want to make sure it gets done", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "It will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today? I've requested the credit and we'll monitor the speed. Goodbye!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
